notes: Fitbit fixes: split nights no longer count time awake as time in bed, yesterday's score is labelled as such, the card refreshes when you come back from Fitbit and has a refresh button, readiness history is now in backups. New: recovery and sleep trend in Progress, a lighter-session or rest-day choice on low-recovery mornings, other apps' workouts named under Strain, Fitbit calorie average in Goals.
